spec_sheets.en:
# Yotoha Engineering · CTO capability spec sheet

Fixed-scope engineering · 48-hour delivery · fixed CNY fees; subject to booking and written scope agreement.

Static inventory: 2,332 declared unit-test functions across 64 test files; the exporter did not execute them. No run supplied; pass rate is unverified.

| Capability | Implementation scope | Test declarations |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| Resilient scraper | Static HTML/JSON/CSV ingestion, bounded retries, deduplication and provenance. | 53 |
| API metering gateway | API key authentication, RPM/TPM limits, SQLite idempotent billing and reconciliation. | 91 |
| Multi-agent mesh | Agent routing, circuit breakers/backoff, CRDT conflict merging and Merkle state sync. | 31 |

| Deliverable | Fixed fee | Scope limit |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Resilient scraper | ¥1,500 | One authorized site, up to 3 static page templates and 10 fields; JSON/CSV export. |
| API metering gateway | ¥3,500 | One upstream API, one SQLite ledger, up to 3 RPM/TPM/prepaid quota configurations. |
| Multi-agent mesh | ¥8,000 | Up to 3 agents/peers in one runtime environment and one workflow; routing, failover and state-sync demo. |

**Delivery & SLA**

- 48 elapsed hours start after scope, acceptance fixtures and booking are agreed, inputs/access are ready and the provider confirms full escrow funding.
- Missing client inputs/access or client dependency outages pause the clock with recorded, mutually agreed stop/resume times; scope changes require a new quote.
- For 7 calendar days after handoff: acknowledge in-scope defects within 4 business hours and fix or provide a working workaround within 9 business hours; one in-scope revision included. Mon–Fri 09:00–18:00, Asia/Shanghai; business hours accrue only in this window.
- Supplier delivery delay earns 10% fee credit per started 24 hours, capped at 30%; missed remediation deadlines earn the same credit, with a combined 30% cap.

**Acceptance & escrow**: Review agreed fixtures within 24 elapsed hours of handoff or list defects; escrow releases only on explicit acceptance, with no automatic release on timeout. This hash checks scope, price, SLA and evidence integrity; it does not prove escrow funding.

Handoff: source, configuration, startup/recovery docs, acceptance tests, fixtures and SHA-256 file manifest; each card includes a verifiable terms hash.

Evidence: scripts/rapid\_lead\_scraper\_resilience.py; scripts/b2b\_api\_gateway\_metering.py / scripts/zero\_support\_reconciliation\_engine.py; scripts/agent\_fleet\_load\_balancer.py / scripts/decentralized\_state\_sync\_protocol.py

Share your objective, sample inputs, runtime constraints and acceptance criteria to confirm booking and scope.

固定范围工程交付 · 48 小时 · CNY 一口价；档期与书面范围确认后生效。

静态盘点：2,332 个单元测试函数声明，分布于 64 个测试文件；此导出器未执行测试。 未提供执行结果，通过率未验证。

| 能力 | 实现范围 | 测试声明 |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| 弹性数据采集器 | 静态 HTML/JSON/CSV 采集、限次重试、去重与来源追踪。 | 53 |
| API 计量网关 | API 密钥鉴权、RPM/TPM 限流、SQLite 幂等计费与账单补偿。 | 91 |
| 多智能体协作网格 | 智能体路由、熔断与退避、CRDT 冲突合并和 Merkle 状态同步。 | 31 |

| 交付包 | 固定价格 | 范围上限 |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| 弹性数据采集器 | ¥1,500 | 1 个授权站点、最多 3 个静态页面模板、10 个字段；JSON/CSV 导出。 |
| API 计量网关 | ¥3,500 | 1 个上游 API、1 个 SQLite 账本、最多 3 档 RPM/TPM/预付配额配置。 |
| 多智能体协作网格 | ¥8,000 | 单一运行环境中最多 3 个智能体/节点、1 条工作流；路由、熔断与状态同步演示。 |

**交付与 SLA**

- 双方确认固定范围、验收样例与档期，资料/访问权限齐备且托管方确认全额入金后，48 个自然小时开始计时。
- 客户资料或权限缺失、客户依赖服务中断时，记录原因与双方确认的暂停/恢复时间；变更范围另行报价。
- 交付后 7 个自然日内，范围内缺陷 4 个工作小时响应、9 个工作小时修复或提供可用替代方案；含一轮范围内修订。 周一至周五 09:00–18:00，Asia/Shanghai，按此工作时段计时。
- 供应方延迟交付每开始 24 小时抵扣服务费 10%，上限 30%；修复时限违约按同一比例抵扣，合计不超过 30%。

**验收与托管**：交付后 24 个自然小时内按约定样例验收或列明缺陷；托管款仅在明确验收后释放，逾期不自动放款。 此哈希仅校验范围、价格、SLA 与证据是否改动，不证明托管款已到账。

交付含源代码、配置、启动/恢复文档、验收测试、样例与 SHA-256 文件清单；每张交付卡含可复核的条款哈希。

证据：scripts/rapid\_lead\_scraper\_resilience.py; scripts/b2b\_api\_gateway\_metering.py / scripts/zero\_support\_reconciliation\_engine.py; scripts/agent\_fleet\_load\_balancer.py / scripts/decentralized\_state\_sync\_protocol.py

请提供目标、输入样例、环境限制与验收标准，以确认档期及固定范围。
